name: toxic-cleaner-ai-dashboard
description: 毒抜きAIダッシュボード - クレーマーの暴言を穏やかなメッセージに変換するシステム

scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others --prefix-colors "magenta,blue,cyan" "npm run dev:frontend:admin" "npm run dev:frontend:client" "npm run dev:backend"
scripts.dev:split: concurrently --kill-others --prefix-colors "magenta,blue,cyan" "npm run dev:frontend:client" "npm run dev:frontend:admin" "npm run dev:backend"
scripts.dev:backend: bash -lc "cd backend && if [ -f .venv/bin/activate ]; then source .venv/bin/activate; fi && python -m uvicorn main:app --reload --port 8000"
scripts.knowledge: bash -lc "cd backend && if [ -f .venv/bin/activate ]; then source .venv/bin/activate; fi && python scripts/ingest_knowledge.py --file ../knowledge.txt --reset"
scripts.knowledge:dry: bash -lc "cd backend && if [ -f .venv/bin/activate ]; then source .venv/bin/activate; fi && python scripts/ingest_knowledge.py --file ../knowledge.txt --dry-run"
scripts.knowledge:ingest: bash -lc "cd backend && if [ -f .venv/bin/activate ]; then source .venv/bin/activate; fi && python scripts/ingest_knowledge.py --file ../knowledge.txt"
scripts.knowledge:ingest:dry: bash -lc "cd backend && if [ -f .venv/bin/activate ]; then source .venv/bin/activate; fi && python scripts/ingest_knowledge.py --file ../knowledge.txt --dry-run"
scripts.predev: lsof -ti :3000 | xargs kill -9 || true && lsof -ti :3001 | xargs kill -9 || true && lsof -ti :8000 | xargs kill -9 || true
